text: Select: [chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id, efo_term, mesh_id, mesh_heading, max_phase_for_ind] Source: [molecule_dictionary, drug_indication] Join: [molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno] Filter: [drug_indication.mesh_id IS NOT NULL AND drug_indication.mesh_heading IS NOT NULL AND molecule_dictionary.therapeutic_flag = 1 AND molecule_dictionary.oral = 1 AND molecule_dictionary.black_box_warning = 0 AND molecule_dictionary.withdrawn_flag = 0] Sort: [mesh_heading ASC, efo_term ASC] Limit: [None]
